d: In one of television's first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

Two adventurers rescue a man bearing a tattooed treasure map on his back. But the quest is far from over—the second crucial map is tattooed on a sheriff's back. Together, they embark on a thrilling hunt, facing danger and mystery in pursuit of hidden riches.
A young man travels to Mexico in search of his brother, who has become involved with a dangerous gang.
Buffalo Bill tries to protect the Indian's land from a gang who want to get the gold buried there.
In Tombstone, a new sheriff vows to clean up the town of outlaws like the O'Hara brothers and is assisted by a strange lawyer who always carries two large law books with him.
